# Upstream provenance

This directory contains the source of `bcder` 0.7.7, with
code unchanged. FastNetMon maintains the package metadata and documentation;
upstream sponsorship and inactive vendored CI files have been removed.

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/NLnetLabs/bcder
- Upstream tag: `v0.7.7`
- Upstream commit: `f9ce2c7d76d9d6d1cee0d91cf5e9d1eee62bffbb`
- License: BSD-3-Clause (see `LICENSE`)

The original authorship and copyright notices are preserved.

The 0.7.7 source was imported from the crates.io release archive, verified
against the checksum in RPKI’s previous lockfile.
